result.title: Fewer Tokens, More Answers: Verifiable-Reward Tuning of an Ornith-Style VLM for Multi-View Driving QA
result.summary: Reasoning-enabled model derivatives must turn intermediate deliberation into a usable answer within a deployment budget. We study that transition in an Ornith checkpoint adapted to multi-camera driving question answering with verifiable rewards. Paired archived outputs show that, on a selected 400-question development screen with a 256-token cap, GRPO increases answer extraction from 78.25% to 90.25% and accuracy from 55.50% to 63.75%. Of 39 wrong-to-correct transitions, 33 begin with an unextractable base response. The base's 87 unextractable responses all reach the token cap. Checkpoint-verified reconstruction on those same questions gives a much smaller first-pass accuracy gain at 512 tokens: +0.75 percentage points, versus +8.25 at 256. A later answer-cued continuation is analyzed separately; it helps the base more and narrows the adapter difference. On the full 2,511-question development set, this recovery-enabled pipeline reduces mean generated tokens from 108.6 to 47.1, while the paired accuracy interval includes zero gain. We frame these findings as adaptation of answer delivery under finite budgets, with explicit selection and provenance limits. Ornith's self-scaffolding lineage and newer reasoning-enabled derivatives such as Bonsai motivate the problem, but our measured results concern Ornith alone and do not establish a shared architectural mechanism or cross-model transfer.

AI.brief_summary: 在多相机驾驶问答上以可验证奖励（GRPO）微调 Ornith 风格 VLM，并在 256/512 token 预算下比较答案可抽取率与准确率，同时报告全量开发集上生成 token 均值下降而配对准确率增益区间包含零。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「有限预算下的答案交付」诊断，包括未抽取响应全部触顶、增益主要来自可抽取性，可作为 THINK 与 STOP/截断决策收益—成本的对照，并提示需核查答案是否真用上生成内容；但无 latent 状态与视觉证据筛选分析。
